remarks: Welcome to 155 Heritage Hill Road, "B". Oenoke Condos A beautiful 1st floor, 1048 sqft end unit ranch style condo. Gorgeous hardwood floors, spacious open floor plan with loads of natural light. Other wonderful features include a modern kitchen with stone counters, SS appliances, large pantry & 2nd entry to the rear yard; numerous windows with upgraded treatments; lot's of closets everywhere including floor to ceiling Bedroom closets with organizers, huge linen & walk-in hall closet & foyer closet. There's a convenient common basement with oversized, storage cage & coin laundry. Assigned parking space is 155-B. Oenoke Condo's has 2 pools, is conveniently close to center of town, train & everything New Canaan. Don't miss this one!
